title: Claude Code's +25% Is a 17% Cut
caption:
I sized a client sprint against a number that expires this weekend.

Anthropic is permanently raising Claude Code's standard weekly limit by 25% on September 14. True. That 25% is measured against the pre-May baseline, not against the +50% boost I've actually been running on since May 13. Index it: 100 before, 150 today, 125 after. Same change, two honest percentages, and the flattering one went on top.

Credit where it's due, they published the 17% themselves in the follow-up. It just wasn't the headline.

Hitting your cap lately?

slides.headline:
+25% Means
17% Less
slides.sub: The temporary +50% weekly boost expires September 13. The permanent level starts the 14th.

slides.title: Both Numbers Are True
items: Before May 13, call the standard weekly limit 100.
The temporary +50% boost put you at 150. It ends September 13.
September 14 sets the new permanent level at 125.
125 against 150 is 0.833. That is 17% below today.
Weekly limits only. The 5-hour window and the API are untouched.

slides.title: Anthropic Said 17%
slides.sub: “Compared to today, this works out to a 17% reduction in weekly limits on Claude Code.” Anthropic, August 29.
